Starting today, Runna subscribers can use the brand-new "Adapt for Heat" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on local temperature and humidity. Details below.

Runna adds heat-aware training tool

Personal running coach app Runna today announced three updates aimed at supporting users throughout their entire training cycle, ranging from hot-weather training to post-race recovery.

The new "Adapt for Heat" feature, launching today, will help users identify cooler running windows and recommend adjusted pace targets based on feels-like temperature, workout duration and specific sessions.

The "Adapt for Heat" feature displays a colour-coded hourly weather forecast, allowing users to quickly identify the best times to run and plan accordingly.

Here's how Runna introduces this new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature. Once users start a race plan ranging from 5K to 50K, the system automatically generates a corresponding programme. These plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of burnout or injury," said Runna head coach and former Olympian Steph Kessell.

Finally, the platform announced that a new feature called "Upcoming Plans" will roll out in August. Users can schedule multiple training plans in advance, with the system seamlessly transitioning from one plan to the next, further streamlining long-term training workflows.

Here's how Runna outlines the benefits of the "Upcoming Plans" feature:

Plan your entire year in minutes: Runners can stack races, mid-term goals and training blocks for an at-a-glance view of the full year. Zero admin between plans: No rebuilding or starting from scratch — your preferred training schedule, projected race times and current fitness level carry over automatically when one plan ends and the next begins. Flexibility on your terms: Every plan can be edited, swapped or removed at any time, giving runners full control over their training experience. Built for progress: Every plan is designed by Runna's expert coaches using proven training principles, supporting sustainable progress, recovery and race-day readiness.
